'''0.29b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added Spanish and French localizations as well as fixing various bugs.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Increased number of parts required for equipment [[modifications]].

===User Interface===
* Added Spanish and French localizations.
* Supplies color in the player's inventory changed to blue.

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed several critical errors leading to game crashes.
* Fixed a matchmaking bug that caused to start matches with fewer players more often than intended.
* Matchmaking will now be restricted to appropriate players’ levels.
* Fixed a bug with 'Keeper of the Sun' gear set. The modifiers have been added.
* Fixed bugs with awarding incorrect achievements.
* Fixed bugs with 'Solstice Days' event. Tokens should now drop correctly.
* Fixed a bug with modification of the first-tier boots.
* Fixed several bugs with sound system.
* Fixed a number of Killcam bugs.
* Corrected a number of localization mistakes.
* Fixed a number of UI bugs.
